panels.description:
k8s generation counter - observed generation number

Explanation:
Some kubernetes objects (mainly those that affect underlying pods) have a generation field that increments as the spec changes. 

The generation field is used internally at kubernetes so that it knows when some action is required at that object.
panels.title: Observed Generation

panels.description: If replayed LSN on replica is equal to current LSN on master, there is no replication lag and then this value shows always 0. Otherwise this value displays the elapsed time since last transaction replayed during streaming replication recovery. If recovery is still in progress this will increase monotonically.
panels.title: Current Replication lag

panels.description: If replayed LSN on replica is equal to current LSN on master, there is no replication lag and then this value shows always 0. Otherwise this graph gives a historical view for elapsed time since last transaction replayed during streaming replication recovery. If recovery is still in progress this will increase monotonically.
panels.title: Replication lag

panels.description: Current memory usage, including all memory regardless of when it was accessed.

targets.expr: sum by (i3labelpodname) (label_replace(container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="$namespace",pod_name=~"$statefulset_name.*"}, "i3labelpodname", "$1", "pod_name", "(.*)")+ on (i3labelpodname) group_left(role) 0 * label_replace(sum by (kubernetes_pod_name) (pg_stat_activity_count{kubernetes_namespace="$namespace",role="$role",cluster_name="$cluster",kubernetes_pod_name=~"$statefulset_name.*"} >0), "i3labelpodname", "$1", "kubernetes_pod_name", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory Usage  vs Limits for PostgreSQL Pod(s)

panels.description: The total amount of "user" and "system" time (per-second average rate over the last 5 minutes)

targets.expr: sum by (i3labelpodname) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",container_name!="POD",image!~".*docker.io_postgres_exporter.*"}[5m]), "i3labelpodname", "$1", "pod_name", "(.*)")+ on (i3labelpodname) group_left(role) 0 * label_replace(sum by (kubernetes_pod_name) (pg_stat_activity_count{kubernetes_namespace="$namespace",cluster_name="$cluster",role="$role"} >0), "i3labelpodname", "$1", "kubernetes_pod_name", "(.*)"))
